name: provenance
description: Skills and agents for building Agent Skills, and for generating well-split, Conventional Commits-formatted git commits.

pr_sync_enabled.title: Auto-sync PR description after push
pr_sync_enabled.description: After a git push on a branch with an open PR, check whether the PR's title/description has drifted from the actual changes and offer to update it via the pr-description-sync skill. Off by default since it inspects and can edit a shared, visible PR.

git_committer_auto_commit.title: Auto-commit without approval
git_committer_auto_commit.description: Let git-committer stage and commit its proposed commit plan without waiting for your approval (it still shows the plan). Off by default since committing rewrites repo history.

git_committer_auto_push.title: Auto-push after committing
git_committer_auto_push.description: Let git-committer push the current branch immediately after committing, without asking first. Independent of git_committer_auto_commit. Off by default since it publishes commits to a shared remote.

branch_merge_monitor_enabled.title: Auto-switch after branch merge
branch_merge_monitor_enabled.description: Periodically check whether the current branch has been merged into the repo's default branch (via a merged PR, a git merge/fast-forward, or otherwise), and if so — and the working tree is clean — automatically check out the default branch and pull, without asking first. Off by default since it switches branches and pulls without confirmation.

branch_merge_check_interval_seconds.title: Branch merge check interval (seconds)
branch_merge_check_interval_seconds.description: How often the branch-merge monitor polls for a merge, in seconds. Only used when branch_merge_monitor_enabled is on.
